verdict.rationale: MI355X is physical hardware paired with the open-source ROCm stack, container toolkit, Kubernetes operator, and on-prem deployment/monitoring tools (SMI, validation suite, metrics exporter), all of which enable a buyer to fully self-host the core product in their own datacenter without dependency on a vendor-hosted service. missing for 10: no independent hands-on account of a full self-hosted deployment lifecycle, and no explicit vendor statement framing self-hosting as a first-class supported use case versus cloud/rental consumption.
